# Amol Veg Resto (Solapur)

> 100% Pure Vegetarian Restaurant in Sakhar Peth, Solapur, Maharashtra, India. Established in 1990.

## Overview
Amol Veg Resto is a premier pure vegetarian dining destination in Solapur, Maharashtra. Located on Karnik Nagar Road near Ashok Chowk in Sakhar Peth, the restaurant specializes in authentic South Indian breakfast, traditional Maharashtrian meals, hearty North Indian and Punjabi curries, Chinese wok specials, tandoor flatbreads, and aromatic filter coffee.

## Quick Facts
- **Entity Name:** Amol Veg Resto (also known as Amol Veg, AMOL VEG RESTO)
- **Dietary Standard:** 100% Pure Vegetarian (Strict vegetarian kitchen with Jain options available)
- **Cuisine Types:** South Indian, North Indian, Punjabi, Maharashtrian, Chinese, Tandoori, Thali, Beverages
- **Price Range:** ₹₹ (Approx. ₹100 – ₹300 per person)
- **Operating Hours:** 11:00 AM – 11:30 PM (All 7 days of the week)
